results.name: The reader preference defaults to Automatic and unsaved edits survive a real background snapshot
The selected PDF is read by the portable Python engine and its printed measurements are shown without clinical inference
No-name filing, Undo and reader switching preserve decisions and cache the current result
Trends displays cached printed values and opens the exact source report page without reparsing
Manufacturer Daily inline measurements populate Water and Noise trends from the actual local reader
Slice thickness has millimetre charts and opens its exact cached source page without hidden analysis
Monthly alignment measurements keep separate printed millimetre series and exact source pages
A real table-position read refreshes the visible chart and keeps eight printed method-position series separate
Content-identical real snapshots do not restart an already displayed trend chart

scope: Actual local host, reader preferences and background snapshot, selected bundled Python PDF reading, conservative printed measurement values/limits, small-window review, no-name filing, Undo and Standard reader cache, saved-value trends and exact source-page navigation without hidden parsing. Generated three-page Basic, manufacturer Daily, slice-thickness, Monthly alignment and table-position PDFs only; no uploaded report, private text or credentials are included.
